title: Descent-restricted subsequences via RSK and evacuation
summary: The length $\mathsf{is}(π)$ of a longest increasing subsequence in a permutation $π$ has been extensively studied. An increasing subsequence is one that has no descents. We study generalizations of this statistic by finding longest subsequences with other descent restrictions. We first consider the statistic which encodes the longest length of a subsequence with a given number of descents. We then generalize this to restrict the descent set of the subsequence.
